messages:
samir: Heads-up: scheduling a maintenance window tonight 23:00 PST / 06:00 UTC for a GPU runtime kernel update in us-west-2. Estimated ~45m. Affects Dedicated & Private; hosted API should be fine but may see minor throttling. Posting statuspage + email drafts below for review.

liz: thanks — can you drop a short statuspage snippet and an email that CS can send? pinging @cody for the customer list.

cody: on it, will keep both concise. do we want to call out pinned runtimes explicitly?

samir: yes, call that out. pinned runtime customers should not be auto-upgraded or restarted.

marta: also confirm if this touches infra autoscaling — customers with pinned capacity shouldn't be impacted by scale actions.

samir: confirmed. snippets below. open to edits.

samir: [statuspage snippet]

```
Scheduled maintenance: GPU runtime kernel update
When: Tonight 23:00 PST (06:00 UTC)
Impact: Short service restarts for Dedicated & Private deployments in us-west-2. Hosted API remains available; occasional throttling possible.
Expected duration: ~45 minutes
What we're doing: installing critical kernel patches and rolling pods to pick up performance fixes.
```

marta: add a short pinned-runtime note — one line.

samir: updated.

samir: [statuspage snippet v2]

```
Scheduled maintenance: GPU runtime kernel update
When: Tonight 23:00 PST (06:00 UTC)
Impact: Brief restarts for Dedicated & Private (us-west-2). Hosted API: no expected downtime, possible minor throttling.
Pinned runtime guidance: Customers who have pinned runtime versions will not be auto-upgraded and will not be restarted during this window.
Expected duration: ~45 minutes
```

cody: email draft for affected customers — short and copy-ready: 

```
Subject: Planned maintenance — runtime kernel update (us-west-2)
Hello {first_name},
We're performing a planned runtime kernel update in us-west-2 on {date} at 23:00 PST. During the ~45 minute window, Dedicated and Private deployments in that region may experience brief restarts. If you've pinned your runtime version, your instances won't be restarted.
What to expect: normal traffic will resume automatically; no action required. If you have strict SLAs or need to reschedule, reply to this message or contact support@redwood.com.
Please check status.redwood.com for live updates.
Thanks,
Redwood Inference Operations
```

liz: looks good. add a single line in the email that links to the statuspage and suggests opening a ticket if errors persist.

samir: done. @deploy-bot can you schedule the statuspage post to go live 15m before the window and queue the email send at 21:00 PST?

deploy-bot: Deploy task created: statuspage/post (id: 4321). Scheduled publish: 05:45:00 UTC. Email campaign queued (campaign id: 9987) — send at 21:00 PST.

marta: I'll ping SRE + CS rotations and add the incident playbook to the CS thread.

liz: approved to send. please include the 'no action required' bullet in the subject preview.

samir: thanks — once deploy-bot confirms publish I'll post the final copy to #announcements.

deploy-bot: statuspage/post 4321 published at 05:45:00 UTC.

liz: great, closing out. :thumbsup:
